meta_description: An FSSAI Advisory Issued On 3rd April 2024 Asked All E-Commerce Food Business Operators (Fbos) To Remove Certain Drinks From The "Health Drinks" And "Energy Drinks" Categorisation On Their Websites. -
body_html: FSSAI advisory issued on April 3, 2024, directs e-commerce companies to remove certain drinks from the “Health Drinks/Energy Drinks” category. All e-commerce firms dealing with food products, must adhere to the FSS (Food Product Standards and Food Additives) Regulations 2011. Non-compliance with these guidelines under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, can result in penalties up to Rs 2 lakh.
